name: Ten New Benchmarks for Optimization
description: Benchmarks are used for testing new optimization algorithms and their variants to evaluate their performance. Most existing benchmarks are smooth functions. This chapter introduces ten new benchmarks with different properties, including noise, discontinuity, parameter estimation and unknown paths.
evaluation_method: best objective value found / convergence rate (often measured vs. number of function evaluations)
general_score_metric: best-found objective value (with convergence curves / evaluations-to-target)
reputation: A specialist set of test functions introduced for optimization research; adopted mainly in numerical optimization and algorithm-development circles rather than broad ML benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark of synthetic/analytical objective functions with varied properties (noise, discontinuity); results depend strongly on evaluation budget and stopping criteria, so direct comparisons require standardized evaluation protocols.
